def pair(b):return [F(*x) for x in b]
def sub(a,b):return [x-y for x,y in zip(a,b)]
def det(a,b,c):return a[0]*(b[1]*c[2]-b[2]*c[1])-a[1]*(b[0]*c[2]-b[2]*c[0])+a[2]*(b[0]*c[1]-b[1]*c[0])
def cramer(o,ray,tri):
 a,b,c=tri;neg_e1=[-x for x in sub(b,a)];neg_e2=[-x for x in sub(c,a)];rhs=sub(a,o)
 denominator=det(ray,neg_e1,neg_e2)
 if denominator==0:return {'determinant':-denominator}
 t=det(rhs,neg_e1,neg_e2)/denominator
 u=det(ray,rhs,neg_e2)/denominator;v=det(ray,neg_e1,rhs)/denominator
 return dict(determinant=-denominator,parameter=t,u=u,v=v,uv=u+v)
def inside(x,b):
 lo,hi=pair(b);assert lo<=x<=hi
